principles: One factor per test; every other setting identical to the control capture.
All captures in a NEW diagnostic copy of the saved RI03 scene; the main UnityProject, RI01-RI03 assets and originals are never edited or saved.
Each test produces 1920x1080 PNG + linear float EXR, with SHA256 and decoded RGBA hashes; state and assets restored and preservation re-checked (as in MAT07/MAT07C/FOLLOWUP04).
Shape changes and material changes are never combined in one test; added objects (option B) are labeled as additions, not as food mesh edits.
Do not repeat NormalOff, MatCapOff, ShadowStrengthZero, CeramicShadowBlur1.0 or the rejected FUP04 blend/FBX.
No Bake/AO, Play, Build & Test, SDK build or upload in any test below unless separately approved (only T6 would need Bake approval and is not recommended now).
A test result is evidence about the tested condition only; no generalization from Caprese to other dishes without their own capture.

fixedConditions.unity: Unity 2022.3.22f1 / lilToon 2.3.4 / BRP / Linear / DX11 (as recorded in MAT07)
fixedConditions.scene: diagnostic copy of Trattoria_ReviewIntegration_RI03.unity (saved scene SHA 5d6e32a9... per lighting_inventory_RI03_F05.json)
fixedConditions.cameras: existing fixed review cameras: FoodCaprese (primary), FoodLamb, FoodPuttanesca, FoodPudding (secondary), EntranceUpper or Sign (outdoor positive control)
fixedConditions.quality: VRC Medium (current index per records); VRC Mobile reported separately only where stated
fixedConditions.lighting: 13 lights as inventoried (12 Baked point, Review_Sun Mixed directional intensity 0.9 soft shadows); existing lightmaps/probes untouched; no rebake
fixedConditions.exposureAndOutput: same camera exposure/post settings as MAT07 baseline; 1920x1080 PNG + linear FLOAT32 EXR
fixedConditions.geometryAndMaterials: RI03 saved state (POSE01 upper toast, Menu/Sign albedos, RI02 materials); scale 0.7825509309768677; Pudding two plates; Water; placements unchanged

controls.negativeRepeat: Capture the unchanged control twice; expected pixel-identical (MAT07/MAT07C baselines matched saved RI02 exactly). Any difference invalidates the test session.
controls.positiveOutdoor: For any light-on/off test, the outdoor EntranceUpper/Sign view must change where realtime sun shadows are visible today (menu stand on wall, street lamp on ground). If it does not change, the toggle did not take effect.
controls.readOnlyFirst: T1/T2 are read-only queries/analyses and must run before any render test.

hypotheses.statement: At the indoor table the Mixed Review_Sun is occluded (Shadowmask probe occlusion), so no realtime light casts shadows on the food.
hypotheses.basis: record: only Review_Sun is realtime-capable; food non-static, probe-lit; observation: no cast shadows in any RI02 food image while outdoor shadows are visible

hypotheses.statement: The probe SH lighting at the table has a weak directional (L1) component relative to its ambient (L0) part, so lilToon form shading has little light direction to work with.
hypotheses.basis: observation: plate slope with ~11-14 deg normal tilt is 200-201 in 8-bit; many baked point lights surround the room

hypotheses.statement: Renderer castShadows/receiveShadows or shadow distance/cascade settings on food/table prevent a realtime shadow even if a light reaches the table.
hypotheses.basis: no record of these renderer flags in the supplied archive

hypotheses.statement: The tablecloth is near display saturation, so weak contact darkening could be clipped in LDR output.
hypotheses.basis: pixels: 41-50% of frame has a 255 channel in Caprese/Lamb/Puttanesca; Pudding only 7.5% and still shows no contact darkening, so H4 alone is unlikely to explain it

hypotheses.statement: lilToon ramp parameters flatten the plate.
hypotheses.basis: already explored by MAT07/MAT07C (rejected variants); NOT re-tested here without new evidence

hypotheses.statement: Shallow plate shape (one tier, ~9 mm local rise) reduces readable form compared with the two-tier anime plate.

tests.title: Linear EXR read of existing captures (cloth and plate headroom)
tests.factor: none (read-only analysis of existing MAT07 baseline / POSE01 EXR on the local machine)
tests.fixed: existing files only; no Unity launch
tests.observe: linear RGB of cloth below plate, cloth far, plate slope windows (same rectangles as analysis_measurements.json), and how many cloth pixels exceed 1.0
tests.interpretPositive: cloth linear values well above 1.0 -> a contact shadow of moderate strength could be invisible; exposure/tonemapping becomes a separate factor to plan
tests.interpretNegative: cloth below 1.0 -> saturation is not hiding shadows; H4 rejected for this view
tests.limits: says nothing about why the plate is flat; single camera
tests.approval: operator approval to read local files (no project change)

tests.title: Read-only probe query at food positions
tests.factor: none (Editor script reads LightProbes.CalculateInterpolatedLightAndOcclusionProbes / SH at plate centre, rim and bread positions in the diagnostic copy; scene not saved)
tests.fixed: diagnostic copy; no render; no save
tests.observe: occlusion probe value for the sun's shadowmask channel at the table; SH L0 vs L1 magnitude and dominant direction
tests.interpretPositive: occlusion ~0 -> supports H1 (sun blocked at table); L1 small vs L0 -> supports H2
tests.interpretNegative: occlusion clearly >0 -> sun should reach the table; investigate H3 next. L1 large -> look elsewhere for flat plate (shader light direction handling, H6)
tests.limits: probe interpolation is not the per-pixel shader result; does not show what lilToon does with SH; API names must be checked against Unity 2022.3 docs by the executor
tests.preservation: diagnostic copy only, discard without saving; record script SHA
tests.approval: user approval for a diagnostic Unity Editor batch run (no Play, no Bake)

tests.title: Hypothesis 0: Review_Sun enabled vs disabled
tests.fixed: all fixedConditions; same cameras FoodCaprese + EntranceUpper
tests.observe: per-pixel PNG and linear EXR difference on plate, bread, cloth around plate; outdoor positive control
tests.interpretPositive: food view difference ~0 while outdoor changes -> sun contributes nothing realtime at the table (consistent with H1)
tests.interpretNegative: food view changes -> sun reaches the table; then whether it casts shadows is still unknown (go to T4)
tests.whatItCannotDecide: Cannot tell whether a new light would produce good shadows (option A), cannot tell probe directionality (H2), cannot prove bake is necessary, cannot separate occlusion from renderer flags (H3) when the difference is zero
tests.limits: one camera per dish; disabling the sun may also change probe-independent terms such as realtime specular; EXR needed to see sub-8-bit changes
tests.preservation: toggle at runtime/editor in diagnostic copy only, restore, verify scene and asset hashes unchanged
tests.approval: user approval for diagnostic Unity capture (no Play, no Bake)

tests.title: Shadow casting only of Review_Sun (conditional on T3 showing a change)
tests.observe: whether any part of the table image changes
tests.interpretPositive: change -> realtime sun shadows do fall on the table
tests.interpretNegative: no change while T3 changed -> sun lights the table but casts no visible shadow there; check renderer flags (H3) by reading, not by trying values
tests.limits: skip entirely if T3 shows no change

tests.title: Option A probe: one limited realtime light for the table
tests.factor: add ONE realtime soft-shadow light (spot or directional), culling mask limited to food/plates/cloth layer, fixed direction from above-front similar to the anime key; nothing else changed
tests.fixed: all fixedConditions; materials unchanged (no MatCap/Normal/Shadow value changes)
tests.observe: plate well and rim gradient, bread underside/contact, cloth contact shadow, overexposure; then the same with Quality = VRC Mobile reported separately
tests.interpretPositive: contact shadows and plate gradient readable without new clipping -> A is a viable candidate for visual selection
tests.interpretNegative: little change -> the lighting path is not the limiting factor at the table; reconsider H6 (shape) or option B
tests.limits: VRC Mobile has shadows off per records, so A's shadows are expected not to appear there; PC frame cost and Quest are not measured by this test; light/shadow follows only this added light
tests.preservation: light added only in the diagnostic copy; removed and hashes rechecked
tests.approval: user approval to create a diagnostic candidate light; adoption into RI04+ is a separate approval

tests.title: Option B probe: painted contact-shadow cards (addition, not mesh edit)
tests.factor: add soft transparent shadow quads under one plate and under the bread only (Caprese); food meshes, materials and lights unchanged
tests.observe: contact readability; z-fighting/sorting with the transparent water glass; visibility at the four food cameras and at a grazing angle
tests.interpretPositive: anime-like contact readable at review cameras -> B is a candidate
tests.interpretNegative: sorting artefacts or obviously pasted look -> reject B
tests.limits: does not respond to lighting; does not change plate form shading; must be labelled as added geometry
tests.preservation: new assets only in the diagnostic copy
tests.approval: user approval to create candidate assets

tests.title: Option C (NOT recommended now): food Static + rebake/AO
tests.approval: Bake/AO explicitly not authorized; listed only for completeness
tests.limits: changes lightmaps scene-wide; food could no longer move; cannot be compared one-factor without a full rebake

order: T4 (only if T3 changes the table)
then user chooses A (T5) and/or B (T6), or keep-current
stopRules: Negative repeat control not pixel-identical -> stop session.
Outdoor positive control unchanged in T3 -> toggle failed, stop and fix procedure.
Any preservation hash mismatch -> stop, report, do not adopt.
